abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter.  Roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability.  For each 3+, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter.  After all of the dice have been rolled, allocate D3 damage points to this fighter.

abilities.name: Headlong Charge
abilities.text: A fighter can use this ability only if they are within 2" of an enemy fighter and have made 2 move actions this activation.  This fighter makes a bonus attack action with its spear.

abilities.name: Wrath of the First Prince
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus attack action.  In addition, a number of hits scored by that attack action equal to half the value of this ability (rounding up) become critical hits instead.  For example, if the value of the ability was 6, 3 hits scored by that attack action would become critical hits instead.

abilities.name: Shield Ram
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, the next time this fighter finishes a move action within 1" of an enemy fighter, pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll a dice.  On a 4-5, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter.  On a 6, allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Brutal Swing
abilities.text: Add half the value of this ability (rounding up) to the damage points allocated by each critical hit from the next attack action made by this fighter this activation.

abilities.name: The True Master's Favour
abilities.text: A fighter can use this ability only if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation.  Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by friendly fighters while they are within 9" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Call to Arms
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction when an enemy fighter ends their move action visible to this fighter and within 3" of this fighter.  Pick another friendly fighter within 3" of this fighter.  That fighter makes a bonus move action.  After that move action that fighter must be within 1" of the enemy fighter that made the move action.

abilities.name: Master Manipulators
abilities.text: When determining who has the initiative, but not when seizing the initiative, if there is a tie, do not roll off. Instead the player of this warband chooses which tied player has the initiative. If multiple warbands have this battle trait, the players of those warbands roll off, and the winner chooses which tied player has the initiative.
